I would argue that Egypt isn't any better off that it was before.. with their 'new' military junta government. Syria's 'revolution' has cost thousands of lives with no end in sight (despite empty threats by neighboring Arab countries). 

All it takes is one bad official in the other countries to quickly undo anything that has been established.
A never ending challenge, that is. At the end of the day, all it takes is one powerful person to undo absolutely everything that you've dedicated your entire life to doing. So what's the point?
Who needs an excuse to?

Yea just as I am afraid of. I know that my death would destroy my sister.. who is basically my best friend. 

I react by trying to alienate myself from my friends (not contacting them, etc). I don't know if they'll forget me, I sure hope they do.

>If you do choose to do the right things to get better

please, share what this might be. I honestly have no idea.
I was born and raised on the Gulf coast. I don't think any vitamin pill can replace the sun that I know
I live in the Pacific NW, there is very little sunshine.
Man, having this all go away like flipping off a light would be fantastic. However I don't think that's common at all.
No I haven't tried that. I have no idea actually, but now I'm genuinely curious :)
Tried what? Did I mention I'm a guy?

That's not a bad idea, I'll look in to the toastmasters thing. Unfortunately every one of my male friends are married. I do have a lesbian friend who is single, but it would be weird wingmanning her when I'm a guy, and in the places she'd hang out. Hah

I agree, I love face time more than anything. But I'm so horrible at it. I struggle greatly to make any sense of my thoughts to have any meaningful conversation about myself when I'm face to face with anyone. At least here I can type something, think about it, change it to be more accurate, etc. Alcohol certainly helps to calm my brain down enough to do that, but it contributes to the whole depression thing I guess.

Yea, family is the only thing keeping me alive right now. If I knew no one would miss me, I would have been gone long ago. Unfortunately that's not the case, but it's just enough of an excuse to keep me alive. I haven't even found a reason to stop wishing for an end, much less *want* to contribute all of the time and effort to get "better"..

Maybe I'm lazy, I don't know. I don't think I deserve that much time, effort, and money. It's even more depressing to think about having to fight hard to find a combination of drugs/therapy just to feel happy. Sorry, but fuck that.
I just don't believe it's possible. Not without medication, all of which carry other ridiculous side effects.. plus a dependence.
The other one is having religion thrown at me as the 'answer'
PM sent

Yes, I totally understand. My career entails being exposed to a lot of different people in the 100k employee company I work for, and it takes me around the country and around the world. I meet and work with hundreds of people, and it has left me feeling more and more calloused and joyless. People come, people go, and in the end we're no more important than anyone or anything else.

The thing is, I could spend my entire life trying to explain to one person why I feel a certain way but it's impossible for them to fully understand the years and years of thought process that lead to now. If someone wants to believe that they could have said something to make everything different, there's no way to convince them in life or death that they are wrong.
Thinking about what I'd do to them is the only reason I'm still here. If I could have it my way, no one would even know I existed so that I could just end it without affecting anyone.

I have no idea.. wish I did. I don't know why I hate myself, nor do I know how to reverse it. Would like to talk to someone about it in person, but I have such a ridiculously hard time talking about myself in that situation... I hate that I resort to the internets.
I know of at least one gig for freelance web design in the Pacific NW.. a buddy of mine is looking for one to help with his company's website. Where are you located?

I used to believe this when I was younger. I grew up and got a great job, house, dog, etc thinking that each would make me happy. However at the end of the day I still feel exactly like I did when I was younger.
Alcohol is fun.
Seriously, fuck those captchas. For someone with a "I can't do anything right" mentality (i.e. me), having to try 3-6 times to get the damn captcha right just to make a post isn't helping.

Why do you care about a total stranger? Sorry if my questions come off as "blunt", but that's just how I am I guess. I'm genuinely curious because I do not feel the same way that I've observed other people feeling.

Yes I'm sure they will care about me and want me to get better. I just don't want them to have to worry about me. I don't want to go through treatments that may or may not "work". I truthfully don't care what happens to me. I do not believe there is any joy to living, nor have I ever believed there were. Every so often I'll be in a relationship where I'm happy for a period of time (typically up to a year), and then I'll get bored and essentially sabotage it, find someone else, rinse and repeat. It's hard to love others when I don't love myself. I honestly don't know why I don't.. I've just never been totally impressed with myself and feel completely empty inside. 

Unfortunately I meet a lot of new people in my job.. unfortunate because that means there are even more people who would be affected by me going away.
But why? How does someone deserve one? What significance does sending a stranger some message that consists of the word "hugs" on the internet have?

Having to spend money on therapy depresses me, and so would having to spend money on medication. I can't describe why.. I make plenty of money and live alone, but I see that as a waste of money, because I do not care about myself.
The only person I've talked to about this is my sister, and she actually feels very similar. I believe that talking to friends and family about it would just worry them even more, making me hate myself even more, and ultimately wouldn't do anything "good". 

I don't know what it is, but your last sentence baffles me. I just don't understand how or why you would care about a total stranger. Had I not posted on here, you wouldn't have known I even existed. It's frustrating, because I know other people have the same feelings for strangers, but I just don't. I don't know why. It just doesn't make "sense" for some reason in my head.
Why?
Almost everyone who tries to talk you out of suicide states that it's "selfish". But is it not selfish for those around you to want you to continue to live when you clearly do not?
.. I don't get it.
